purpose: Z0 source/index baseline; not complete atomic traceability or product acceptance
scope: Local Z0 inventory only; no migration, provider or product changes authorized here

decisionAuthority.ordinaryProductChoices: Explicitly delegated by owner; select and document professional defaults without repeated product questionnaires
decisionAuthority.separateAuthority: Protected-workflow exceptions, production data changes, live connections/costs and material financial/security/permission changes still require scoped authority; delegation does not bypass preservation controls

DEC01.choice: Keep Next.js/NestJS/Prisma; complete source capabilities; disclose literal technology deviation

DEC02.choice: Payment during registration only for definitively priced services; negotiated services require a final quote accepted by the customer; retain workflow, QC and idempotency

DEC03.choice: Optional moderated public order/service reviews; no internal staff identity/profile disclosure; retain existing private feedback and complaints

DEC04.choice: Four working hours for the first meaningful public support reply, not resolution time. Versioned configurable Asia/Tehran calendar; default Saturday–Thursday 09:00–18:00, Friday and registered holidays closed. Automated replies/internal notes do not count; customer-wait does not pause first-response clock. Resolution metric separate; preserve legacy tickets.
DEC04.implementationAuthority: Target policy only. No blanket protected-source exception, production migration, live connection, cost, account merge or financial mutation authorization.

DEC05.choice: Eligible service on a working day strictly before 14:00 Asia/Tehran, atomic capacity reservation. Payment reservation lasts 15 minutes capped at 14:00; retry never extends it. Delivery by 21:00 only after successful payment inside valid hold. Late verified funds require financial reconciliation, without automatic refund or same/next-day commitment absent customer consent. Snapshot calendar/rules; live providers deferred.
DEC05.implementationAuthority: Target policy only. No blanket protected-source exception, production migration, live connection, cost, account merge or financial mutation authorization.

DEC06.choice: Add wallet top-up and order payment from wallet balance, retaining existing wallet/refunds; balanced ledger, concurrency and duplicate-spend prevention required. Live gateway remains deferred; no production migration authorized by this record

DEC07.choice: Keep all current identifier/document formats for now, including new orders; do not activate the proposed new source format or rewrite historic identifiers. Do not fabricate deadlines; any literal source-format deviation remains disclosed

DEC08.choice: Owner delegated the choice; interpret original operator as existing support role. Keep four roles, scopes and capabilities; no fifth role, new runtime alias or permission expansion

DEC09.choice: Owner accepted the proposed preservation of current API routes, with explicit documentation of source path/method differences. Use validated domain commands, not a generic direct status setter; do not add compatibility aliases merely for literal source matching

DEC10.choice: Live payment/SMS/email/storage/antivirus and AI engine remain deferred. Complete infrastructure and local/mock tests only; live acceptance and whole-scope completion claims stay open until separately authorized and evidenced

DEC11.choice: v4 plus addendum for technical logic; UI blueprint for interaction; preserve additional initial capabilities; approve financial/SLA/cancellation/privacy conflicts separately

DEC12.choice: Explicit D4 transition rows take precedence over blanket nonfinal-cancel sentence; preserve existing prepayment customer cancellation. Ops paid/assigned refund 100%; in_progress follows currently approved refund policy. QC/delivery use revision/dispute routes; disputed exits only resolve-dispute. Partial-refund remainder requires explicit finance disposition, never automatic release.
DEC12.implementationAuthority: Target policy only. No blanket protected-source exception, production migration, live connection, cost, account merge or financial mutation authorization.

DEC13.choice: Command-specific proxy capability with explicit true owner/subject and separate admin actor audit. No impersonation/token fabrication; Support gets no payment/settlement authority. Ops/Finance remain within their own scopes; Super Admin does not bypass state/QC/financial preconditions. Per-command permission implementation remains a separately authorized package.
DEC13.implementationAuthority: Target policy only. No blanket protected-source exception, production migration, live connection, cost, account merge or financial mutation authorization.

DEC14.choice: Preserve current design system, two themes and canonical pages. Apply D5 section/tab semantics additively; entity drawers are progressive enhancements with direct-page fallback, URL allowlists, focus/dirty/pending guards and no permission bypass. No new brand, removed page or runtime acceptance inferred

DEC15.choice: Verified unique email can identify an account; no automatic legacy-account linking/merging by similar email. Preserve password/mobile/OTP/recovery. Optional email; nonblocking onboarding; collaboration interest cannot grant executor capability. SMS/email live sending remains deferred. Auth/DB changes require scoped implementation approval.
DEC15.implementationAuthority: Target policy only. No blanket protected-source exception, production migration, live connection, cost, account merge or financial mutation authorization.

DEC16.choice: Metrics/rules/AI are proposals and alerts only; sensitive employee status/access effects require authorized human command plus audit. Existing automatic under_review job change is a later protected package. Server trims and rejects blank reasons for sensitive commands that actually consume a reason; keep approved customer confirmation without decorative unused note. Unknown data is not zero or definite risk.
DEC16.implementationAuthority: Target policy only. No blanket protected-source exception, production migration, live connection, cost, account merge or financial mutation authorization.
